courses.title: Measures
courses.blurb: Time, money, length, mass and capacity — the measurement strand early primary expects before ratio work.

courses.title: First numbers
courses.blurb: Bonds, tables, and the four operations, drilled until a later course can assume them. Then place value and a first fraction.

courses.title: Pre-algebra
courses.blurb: The whole number strand, ratio, and the first letters. This is the KS3 opening, before quadratics.
books: KS3 Higher study guide and workbook

courses.title: Geometry
courses.blurb: Angles, polygons, circles, area and volume, Pythagoras, similarity, then a coordinate grid.

courses.title: Algebra
courses.blurb: Indices through quadratics, simultaneous equations, sequences, and the first logarithms.

courses.title: Trigonometry
courses.blurb: Right-angled triangles first, then the unit circle, identities, and equations.

courses.title: Higher certificate
courses.blurb: One school road, KS3 through the Higher course, in a single tree. Use it whole, or after the split courses.
books: KS3 Higher study guide and workbook

courses.title: Precalculus
courses.blurb: Conics, parametric and polar form, and the last algebra a calculus course assumes. Companion to Functions.

courses.title: Functions
courses.blurb: The bridge. Notation, transformations, then the families a diploma or a calculus course expects.

courses.title: Analysis SL
courses.blurb: The standard-level half of Analysis and approaches. Same order as the HL tree, with the HL-only topics left out.
books: Haese Mathematics, Analysis and approaches HL

courses.title: Analysis HL
courses.blurb: The diploma this room was built around. Five units, HL topics marked, a worked example and five questions on each.
books: Haese Mathematics, Analysis and approaches HL

courses.title: Applications
courses.blurb: Models, measure, data, and a lighter calculus. The Applications and interpretation path, not the proof path.
books: Haese Mathematics, Applications and interpretation SL

courses.title: Calculus
courses.blurb: Rate of change, then area. The order of Thompson and the skills workbook, using the diploma calculus as the spine.

courses.title: Statistics
courses.blurb: From a mean and a tree diagram to the binomial, the normal, and Bayes.

courses.title: Linear algebra
courses.blurb: Vectors, then matrices: a determinant, a matrix times a vector, and a linear system.

courses.title: Mechanics
courses.blurb: Constant acceleration, forces, and projectiles — the applied half of A-level Maths / first-year physics maths.

courses.title: The infinite
courses.blurb: Finite sums, then sums that do not stop. Euler’s order: geometric series, then the exponential series.
books: Euler, Analysis of the Infinite, Books I and II

courses.title: Topology
courses.blurb: A first foothold, not the whole graduate course: finite sets, subsets, unions, and which numbers sit in an interval.

aa-sl.title: Analysis, standard level
aa-sl.units: AA SL = AA HL tree with HL leaves filtered out

topics.title: From a chord to a derivative

leaves.title: A partial sum of powers of one half

topics.title: Indices & surds
topics.blurb: Powers, roots, and rationalising a denominator.
topics.hlLink: You need this before logs, binomial expansions, and exact trig values.

topics.title: Expand, factor, rearrange
topics.blurb: The algebra you are expected to do without thinking.
topics.hlLink: Every HL paper hides marks inside clean factorising.

topics.title: Lines & equations
topics.hlLink: Tangents, normals, and simultaneous conditions all start here.

topics.title: Quadratics
topics.hlLink: HL functions live on vertex form, equal roots, and intersections.

topics.title: Exponents & logs
topics.blurb: The log laws before the HL questions get clever.
topics.hlLink: Inverse of an exponential, and half of the algebra paper, sits on this.

topics.title: Function notation
topics.blurb: Evaluate, compose, invert a linear, and name a domain.
topics.hlLink: Paper 1 opens on $fcirc g$ and $f^{-1}$ more often than people expect.

topics.title: Right-triangle trig
topics.hlLink: HL identities are unpleasant if $sin 60^{circ}$ is not instant.

topics.title: Data & chance
topics.blurb: Mean, median, and the first probability rules.
topics.hlLink: Combined events and binomial probability assume these without a reminder.

strands.name: Number & algebra
strands.blurb: Sequences, logs, the binomial theorem, and complex numbers.

strands.name: Functions
strands.blurb: Composition, inverses, quadratics, and rational graphs.

strands.name: Trigonometry
strands.blurb: Exact values, identities, radians, and triangle geometry.

strands.name: Calculus
strands.blurb: Derivatives, integrals, area, kinematics, and simple DEs.

strands.name: Statistics & probability
strands.blurb: Combined events, binomial models, data, and the normal curve.

questions.title: A point on the unit circle
